Greer Amps browse by type volume/amplification amplification preamp / clean boost browse by type distortion/fuzz/overdrive distortion browse by enclosure pedal Greer Amps Sweetback Driver Published on October 9, 2005 Greer Amps boost / preamp distortion pedal Information Nick Greer Amplification The Sonic Boom's angry brother! The Turn and Burn knob adds dirt and hair all the way up the dial. It hisses and pops while being set, but stops immediately and is very quiet when played. With the knob fully to the left, it is the exact level feeding it. If you want more 'Mean' to your boost, this is the one!
